name: The St. Regis Bahia Beach Resort
insider_take: This oceanfront sanctuary sits on a former coconut plantation within the stunning El Yunque rainforest backdrop—the only tropical rainforest in the U.S. National Forest System.
whats_special: The resort features Robert Trent Jones Jr.'s championship golf course that winds through ancient coconut groves and alongside pristine beaches. As Puerto Rico's first luxury eco-resort, it seamlessly blends sustainable luxury with Caribbean elegance, offering direct access to both rainforest adventures and world-class water sports.
pro_tip: Book the Plantation House suites for the most authentic experience—these restored buildings from the original coconut plantation offer unparalleled views of both ocean and rainforest canopy.
dont_miss: Take the complimentary nature walk through the resort's 483-acre preserve to spot native coquí frogs and exotic birds, then unwind at the award-winning Remède Spa featuring treatments inspired by indigenous Taíno healing traditions.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on pristine Bahia Beach
Championship Robert Trent Jones Jr. golf course on-site
Signature St. Regis butler service and luxury amenities
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with rainforest setting
cons: Remote location requires travel time to explore Puerto Rico attractions
